verdict.rationale: HumanLayer lets you control and redirect a running task from app.humanlayer.com on any machine or phone, and tasks keep a history that can continue across agents and workstations. Tasks are also backed by worktrees, and collaborative prompt drafting supports steering the agent. However, nothing documents a human directly taking over the work in an editor or terminal. Missing for 10: explicit editor/IDE handoff, terminal attach/takeover of a live session, documented flow for pausing an agent and finishing the work manually, hands-on corroboration.
